step1_create_docs.description: Create 3 test docs with tags [test-batch, ml-optimization, e2e-verify]

step2_tag_registry.description: List current tag registry via kb_tags_list
step2_tag_registry.note: Newly created tags not yet in global registry; only persisted after explicit tag update

step3_update_tags.description: Run kb_doc_update_tags to add/change tags on docs

step4_tag_retrieval.note: Tag-based retrieval works after explicit tag assignment. Cross-KB search returns docs with kb_id and kb_name metadata.

step5_orphan_check.description: Run kb_tags_cleanup(dry_run=true) to check for orphan tags
step5_orphan_check.note: Our test tags (test-batch, ml-optimization, e2e-verify, etc.) are all referenced. Only 2 legacy orphan tags found.

step6_batch_delete.description: Run kb_doc_batch_delete on the 3 test docs

step7_verify_removal.note: All 3 test docs successfully removed. KB has 6 remaining documents (pre-existing + sibling scenario docs).

observations.tag_lifecycle: Tags assigned during doc_create are stored but NOT auto-registered in global tag registry. They only appear in kb_doc_get_by_tag after explicit kb_doc_update_tags call. Tag registry population appears lazy/eventual.
observations.batch_delete_latency: 3 docs deleted in single batch call with zero failures.
observations.orphan_detection: kb_tags_cleanup correctly identifies unreferenced tags. dry_run mode safe for pre-deletion audit.
observations.tag_retrieval: Cross-KB by-tag search works correctly; returns full document metadata including kb_id, kb_path, kb_name.
observations.vector_graph_consistency: Vector index and graph index re-index happen asynchronously after tag updates. Some docs still show old collection names during re-indexing.
